MOVEMENT PROGRESSION GUIDE
As an athlete and/or coach, it is crucial to understand positions in movements. Here
we will be presenting a series of images that showcase key positions for development.
By understanding and practicing these key positions, you can develop your skills,
improve your performance, and reduce the risk of injury.
We encourage you to proactively add notes to each image if we go through them in the
seminar and incorporate these positions into your training routine.
Movements
Eccentric sit-up:
•
Feet and knees together tight
• Heels close into the butt
• Ribcage tucked in
• Only lower back touches the floor
